messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
君は別の道を取るべきだ、 彼は私が泣いているのを見て答えた、 もしこの野蛮な場所から逃れたいなら；

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | A | dative preposition “to” (marks the indirect object) | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (no Japanese equivalent) | | te | 2nd‑person singular pronoun “you” (accusative) | 君は | “you” (topic) | OK | | convien | impersonal verb “it is obligatory / it behoves” | べきだ | “should / ought to” | OK | | tenere | infinitive “to hold / undertake” | 取る | “to take / hold” | OK | | altro | adjective “another” | 別の | “another” | OK | | vïaggio | noun “journey / course” | 道 | “road / path (metaphorical journey)” | OK | | rispuose | verb “replied” (3sg past) | 答えた | “replied” | OK | | poi | adverb “after” (temporal) | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (expressed by the te‑form) | | che | conjunction “that / when” (subordinator) | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (expressed by the te‑form) | | lagrimar | infinitive “to weep” | 泣いている | “weeping” (progressive) | OK | | mi | 1st‑person singular pronoun “me” (accusative) | 私が | “I (subject of weeping)” | OK | | vide | verb “saw” (3sg past) | 見て | “seeing / having seen” (te‑form) | OK | | se | conditional conjunction “if” | もし | “if” | OK | | vuo' | verb “wish / want” (2sg present) | 逃げたい | “want to escape” (desire expressed) | OK | | campar | infinitive “to escape” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (merged into 逃げたい) | | d' | preposition “from / of” | から | “from” | OK | | esto | demonstrative adjective “this” | この | “this” | OK | | loco | noun “place” | 場所 | “place” | OK | | selvaggio | adjective “savage” | 野蛮な | “savage / barbaric” | OK |
---
### Items to Note
**UNNECESSARY (source side – omitted in Japanese)** - **A** – Japanese does not require a dative preposition here. - **poi** – Temporal “after” is encoded by the te‑form of the verb. - **che** – Subordinating “that/when” is likewise encoded by the te‑form. - **campar** – The meaning “to escape” is subsumed in the desire form **逃げたい**.
**UNNECESSARY (target side – added for Japanese grammar)** - **彼は** – Subject pronoun added for clarity; not present in the source. - **のを** – Nominalizer required for the “see …” construction; not in the source. - **なら** – Conditional ending needed in Japanese; the source already has the conditional conjunction **se**.
No missing, wrong, or grammar‑agreement errors were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
